title: 3D with just code
author: Free_Afternoon_7349
selftext:
Some of you may enjoy this, I made it a couple weeks back as a fun weekend project. 

There's basically no assets in the game (just a typescript client + threejs as only dep), the cars started as a basic block and then I just iterated until it was basically this. Had fun with the physics and ground interactions as well. 

The [game ](https://4d893272a35587-p3104.preview.versors.com/)is kinda challenging, only beat it on hard one time

comments.author: ledniv
comments.body:
Pretty cool. You should tell Claude (or whatever) to stop selecting/zooming input in the page when on mobile. Otherwise holding your finger on a button selects it and turns on the zoom glass thingy. 

  
Also would be great to have a minimap and a pause/restart button.

  
The 3d models look really good and the car physics are impressive. How did you prompt for them?

replies.author: Free_Afternoon_7349
replies.body:
yeah sorry about the mobile thing, super annoying - I added mobile at the end as an afterthought and didn't play test it very much. Almost all the building was done on a browser on computer. 

From building it perspective, it was just a lot of iteration and fixing one thing at a time. Most of the work went into the ground and playing with the physics and the little voxels that fly up when you drift. I was having a bunch of fun doing that. So I have like 4 or 5 ground types and the car behaves diff on each.  
  
For the cars it was telling the AI to fix each thing one at a time, and like adjusting it until it looked decent (maybe like 30-50 back n forth to get the car from basically a block with circles into the dune buggie style it is now)
